column1: # Size budget for every authored SKILL.md, read by scripts/check-skill-size.sh.
# Columns are separated by one tab: <skill>  <max lines>  <max bytes>
# The `*` row is the default budget every skill gets. A named row records a
# ceiling for a skill that is already over the default; set each number to the
# skill's current size, or to the default where the skill is inside it.
# Ceilings only come down. When a skill shrinks, lower its row to the new size
# in the same pull request, and delete the row once the skill fits the default.
# Raising a ceiling means editing this file, so the increase shows in review.
# Reference files under a skill's references/ directory are not counted.
